original_score: ascending-dimension separate RN-FP64 subtraction, multiplication, addition; strict squared score > frozen U_star_squared
safe_prune: AABB directed lower norm > RN sqrt(U_star_squared); identical cutoff to inherited point-set safe keeper

arithmetic.endpoints: min/max cached projections +-ETA, nextafter FP64 outward, then FP32 outward
arithmetic.bound: coordinate positive gaps, square/add/sqrt each rounded down; nondecreasing sums; inherited common margin subtracted down
arithmetic.basis: exact inherited full contractive stored matrix; no refit

estimator: integer pooled hard object counts; Fraction comparisons; each level standalone, not summed across hierarchy

stage_A.middle: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; measured but not promoted; no Stage B

formats: INT4 outward enclosing decoded UINT8, only if admitted
stage_B.uint_grid: query-independent shared64D FP64 scale and offset; 1024B total per format; directional mul/add decoded endpoints; verify all enclosure nesting
stage_B.accounting: record payload/alignment AND full scale/offset/shared/query/basis overhead separately; no hidden overhead

gates: G1 all projected endpoint coverage, including coordinate envelope
G2 AABB lower <=point-set safe lower <=original truth norm
G3 zero original strict-squared false prunes
G5 quantized mask/enclosure nesting if admitted; otherwise N/A
extra24 all-member independent original-region replay,72 prefixes

execution.resource_guard: single CPU affinity, hidden CUDA, BLAS/OMP/MKL1, task flock, nice10
execution.disruptive_operations: none; no process signals, GPU settings or shared service changes
